title: outbox enqueue: INSERT without OR IGNORE allows duplicate (message_id, peer_user_id, message) rows
description: OutboxStore::enqueue does a plain INSERT with no ON CONFLICT clause. The outbox PK is (message_id, peer_user_id, kind). If enqueue is called twice for the same (message_id, peer_user_id) — e.g. from a retry path or a double-call bug — the second INSERT will fail with a UNIQUE constraint violation, which db_err maps to KithError::Validation. The caller (kith-peer deliver handler or insert_outbound_message) will surface this as an invalidArguments error rather than a silent no-op. Compare with enqueue_receipt which uses INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE. For message kind, a duplicate enqueue call is a programming error and should fail loudly, which it does — but the error type (Validation, surfaced as invalidArguments) is wrong. It should surface as a serverFail (internal invariant violated). Document this clearly or add OR IGNORE to make it idempotent like enqueue_receipt. Note: KITH-hqrw.59 covers idempotency; this covers the error classification on duplicate.
